name: Energy
summary: Electricity systems, grid capacity, generation, data center load, industrial power demand, utility regulation, and the energy infrastructure required for frontier systems to scale.
watch_questions: Which frontier systems are becoming local grid-capacity questions rather than only technology questions?
Where do power demand, utility regulation, interconnection, and public legitimacy become binding constraints?
When do large-load rate and transmission decisions become completed infrastructure, customer service, and measured reliability?
Which assets connect installed capacity to availability, dispatch, frequency response, customer reliability, restoration, and cost?
Which recurring measures retain a compatible unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and revision history?
Where does a method change or series break require the longitudinal claim to stop?
